name: applesauce
description: One MCP server for Calendar, Reminders, Mail, Notes, Contacts, Shortcuts, Spotlight and System on your Mac.
long_description: applesauce is a native macOS program. It lets your AI assistant read and change your Calendar, Reminders, Mail, Notes and Contacts, run Shortcuts, search files with Spotlight, and use the clipboard and notifications. macOS asks for permission the first time each app is used. The bundle is ad-hoc signed, so macOS asks again after each update. Ask Claude to run the doctor tool to see each permission and how to fix it.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Hide every tool that changes data. Your assistant can then only read.

modules.title: Only these modules
modules.description: Optional. Comma-separated list. Leave empty for all modules. Names: calendar, reminders, mail, notes, contacts, shortcuts, spotlight, system.

disable.title: Turn off these modules
disable.description: Optional. Comma-separated list of modules to turn off, for example mail,notes. Leave empty to turn none off.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Show the applesauce version, enabled modules, and the state of each macOS permission, with the exact step that fixes a missing one. Use it first when a tool fails with PERMISSION_DENIED.

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: List all calendars with their id, type, source and whether they allow changes.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List events between start and end, sorted by start time, from one calendar or all. Dates are ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-12 or 2026-11-12T09:30:00+01:00. A date-only end includes that whole day. The range is at most 366 days.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Find events whose title, location or notes contain the query (ignores case). Without start and end it looks 30 days back and 30 days ahead. Dates are ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-12 or 2026-11-12T09:30:00+01:00. The range is at most 366 days.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get one event with all its details. Dates are returned in ISO 8601 with an offset.

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create an event. Dates are ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-12 or 2026-11-12T09:30:00+01:00. With date-only start and end, or all_day true, it is an all-day event and end is the last day. alerts and repeat are optional.

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Change fields of an event. Send only the fields to change. An empty string clears location, notes or url. Dates are ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-12 or 2026-11-12T09:30:00+01:00. alerts replaces all alerts, and calendar moves the event. For a recurring event, span future changes this and all later occurrences and needs confirm true. Changing repeat needs span future.

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Delete an event. For a recurring event, span chooses one occurrence or all later ones.

tools.name: delete_calendar
tools.description: Delete an empty calendar. It is refused when the calendar has an event from 10 years back to 10 years ahead, is read-only, subscribed or a birthday calendar, or is the default calendar. Needs confirm true, also for an empty calendar. Without it nothing is deleted.

tools.name: list_reminder_lists
tools.description: List all reminder lists with their id, source and whether they allow changes.

tools.name: create_reminder_list
tools.description: Create a reminder list. It fails when a list with the same name already exists.

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.description: List reminders, sorted by due date, from one list or all. By default only incomplete ones. Dates are ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-12 or 2026-11-12T09:30:00+01:00. A date-only due_end includes that whole day. Reminders without a due date are left out when a due range is given.

tools.name: search_reminders
tools.description: Find reminders whose title or notes contain the query (ignores case), in all lists, complete and incomplete.

tools.name: get_reminder
tools.description: Get one reminder with all its details. Dates are returned in ISO 8601 with an offset.

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Create a reminder. The due date is ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-12 or 2026-11-12T09:30:00+01:00. A date-only due has a day but no time. Subtasks and tags are not supported.

tools.name: update_reminder
tools.description: Change fields of a reminder. Send only the fields to change. An empty string clears due, notes or url. list moves the reminder to another list. The due date is ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-12 or 2026-11-12T09:30:00+01:00.

tools.name: complete_reminder
tools.description: Mark a reminder as completed, or as not completed with completed set to false.

tools.name: delete_reminder
tools.description: Delete a reminder.

tools.name: delete_reminder_list
tools.description: Delete an empty reminder list. It is refused when the list has any reminder (completed or not), is read-only, or is the default list. Needs confirm true, also for an empty list. Without it nothing is deleted.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List the mail accounts with their id, name and email addresses.

tools.name: list_mailboxes
tools.description: List mailboxes with their path and unread count, for all accounts or one. Gmail labels show as mailboxes.

tools.name: search_mail
tools.description: Search mail, newest first. All filters combine. With Full Disk Access the search is fast and covers all mail. Without it, the search is slower, needs 'mailbox', and covers the date range only (default: last 30 days); 'to' and 'has_attachments' do not work then. Dates are ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-12 or 2026-11-12T09:30:00+01:00.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Get one message: headers, plain text body (cut at 100000 characters) and the numbered names and sizes of attachments. Attachment content is not returned here. Use get_mail_attachment for that.

tools.name: get_mail_attachment
tools.description: Save one attachment of a message as a file on this Mac and return its absolute path. Images are also returned as an image. PDF, text, RTF, DOC and DOCX files are also returned as text (cut at 100000 characters). Other types return the path only. Files above 25 MB are refused. The file is kept for 24 hours. Needs 'confirm' true on every call. Ask the user first.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Save a plain text draft in Mail, with files attached when attachments is given. Nothing is sent. If Mail is not running, applesauce opens it hidden in the background and leaves it open.

tools.name: send_draft
tools.description: Send a draft that is saved in a Drafts mailbox, given its id from search_mail. Mail cannot send a saved draft, so applesauce builds a new message from it, sends it, and then deletes the old draft. Without confirm true nothing is sent: the result shows the subject, sender, recipients and attachment names. Sending cannot be undone.

tools.name: send_mail
tools.description: Send a plain text email, with files attached when attachments is given. Without confirm true nothing is sent: the message is saved as a draft. If Mail is not running, applesauce opens it hidden in the background and leaves it open. Sending cannot be undone.

tools.name: forward_message
tools.description: Forward a message as plain text, with its attachments unless include_attachments is false. The subject is Fwd: and the original subject, followed by your text, a header block and the original text. Without confirm true nothing is sent: the message is saved as a draft. If Mail is not running, applesauce opens it hidden in the background and leaves it open. Sending cannot be undone.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Reply to a message with plain text. Mail adds the quoted original. Without confirm true nothing is sent: the message is saved as a draft. If Mail is not running, applesauce opens it hidden in the background and leaves it open.

tools.name: move_message
tools.description: Move messages (at most 100) to a mailbox. If Mail is not running, applesauce opens it hidden in the background and leaves it open.

tools.name: flag_message
tools.description: Flag or unflag messages (at most 100). Give 'color' (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple or gray) to flag with a color. If Mail is not running, applesauce opens it hidden in the background and leaves it open.

tools.name: mark_read
tools.description: Mark messages (at most 100) as read or unread. If Mail is not running, applesauce opens it hidden in the background and leaves it open.

tools.name: delete_message
tools.description: Delete messages (at most 100). Mail moves them to the Trash mailbox. If Mail is not running, applesauce opens it hidden in the background and leaves it open.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List the Notes folders with their account, note count and id.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search notes by title and body text. Title matches come first, then body matches, newest first in each group. The body is searched only when the title matches are fewer than 'limit'. Locked notes can match by title only. Large libraries are slow, so give 'folder' when you can.

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Get one note: name, folder, account, dates and the plain text body (cut at 100000 characters). Locked notes are not read. Attachments are listed (number, name, type) but their content is not returned. Use get_note_attachment for that.

tools.name: get_note_attachment
tools.description: Save one attachment of a note as a file on this Mac and return its absolute path. Images are also returned as an image. PDF, text, RTF, DOC and DOCX files are also returned as text (cut at 100000 characters). Other types return the path only. Files above 25 MB are refused. Notes cannot save drawings, scans, tables and links. Locked notes are not read. The file is kept for 24 hours. Needs 'confirm' true on every call. Ask the user first.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create a note from plain text. The title becomes the first line (a heading). Notes uses the default folder when 'folder' is not given.

tools.name: append_to_note
tools.description: Add plain text as a new paragraph at the end of a note. Notes writes the whole note again, so some rich content (for example a drawing) can change. Locked notes are not changed.

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Change the title or the plain text body of a note. Give title, body or both. body replaces the whole body, and the title stays as the first line. title alone renames the note. The result has previous_title and previous_body, so the change can be undone. Notes writes the whole note again, so rich content can change. Locked notes are not changed.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a Notes folder. Give parent to make it inside another folder. A folder with the same name in the same place is refused.

tools.name: move_note
tools.description: Move a note to a folder. The note id can change after a move. Use the id in the result.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Delete a note. Notes moves it to the Recently Deleted folder, where it stays for 30 days.

tools.name: delete_folder
tools.description: Delete an empty Notes folder. It is refused when the folder holds a note or a subfolder, for built-in folders, and for the default or only folder of an account. Needs confirm true, also for an empty folder. Without it nothing is deleted.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Find contacts. The query matches name, organization and email (any case), and phone numbers when the query looks like a phone number. All words of the query must match. Returns name, organization, emails and phones. Use get_contact for the full card. Notes are never returned.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact with all details: name, organization, job title, emails and phones with labels, postal addresses and birthday. Notes are never returned.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact. It refuses when a contact with the same full name or email exists, unless allow_duplicate is true. Notes are not supported.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Change a contact. Text fields replace the old value. Emails and phones change with add and remove arguments. The result has the old values of the changed fields. Notes are not supported.

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.description: Delete a contact. Needs confirm true. Without it nothing is deleted, and the result shows the contact. The result of a delete has a full copy and the arguments for create_contact. Notes are not copied. macOS refuses to delete a contact that has a note, and then nothing changes. A contact linked from several cards is refused.

tools.name: list_shortcuts
tools.description: List the names of the shortcuts in the Shortcuts app, all or from one folder.

tools.name: run_shortcut
tools.description: Run a shortcut by name and wait for it (up to 120 seconds). A shortcut can do anything on this Mac, so run only what the user asked for. You can pass text as input. Text output is returned. Other output types are only described by type and size.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search files and folders with Spotlight. The query is plain words, like in Spotlight. With 'kind', every word must be in the file name or at the start of a word in the content. Returns path, name, kind, size and modified date. Files that no longer exist are skipped.

tools.name: get_clipboard
tools.description: Read the text on the clipboard. Only text is returned. If the clipboard holds something else, for example an image, the answer says so.

tools.name: set_clipboard
tools.description: Replace the clipboard with this text.

tools.name: notify
tools.description: Show a macOS notification.

tools.name: open
tools.description: Open a web page, an email draft or a file in its default app. Give exactly one of 'url' (http, https or mailto) or 'path' (a file or folder that exists).
